$comment: V3 _elementor_data setting → V4 engine render behaviour. Built from Oral-Care build (2026-07-26) + v4-engine.md. Each entry: does the V4 engine (4.2.0) render this V3 setting reliably? If not, what's the fallback?

typography_font_size.root_cause: Elementor applies custom typography only when typography_typography='custom' is set. Without the flag, typography_font_size is silently ignored and the theme/kit default applies.
typography_font_size.observed: Set typography_font_size:{unit:'px',size:64} on h2 → rendered 24px (theme default).

typography_font_family.root_cause: Font-family applies from widget setting only when typography_typography='custom' is set. Otherwise the kit/theme default wins. A global CSS rule (body h2 { font-family: ... }) is more reliable.
typography_font_family.fallback: CSS: body.page-id-N h2 { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif !important; }

background_image.root_cause: Container background_image with id:null (external URL, no WP media attachment) does not render under V4. The V4 engine expects a media attachment ID. External URLs in background_image are dropped silently.
background_image.observed: Set background_image:{url:'https://framerusercontent.com/...', id:null} on container → no background-image in rendered HTML.
background_image.required_companion: id: <wp-media-attachment-id> (upload image to WP media first)
background_image.fallback: CSS: body.page-id-N .<section> { background-image: url('...') !important; background-size: cover !important; } + ::before overlay for darkening

background_background.notes: background_background:'classic' is required as the companion to background_image. It renders (appears in data-settings) but alone does not paint an image.

background_color.notes: Solid background_color on containers renders correctly under V4.

background_overlay.root_cause: V4 renders background_overlay with different markup (.elementor-background-overlay div) and the opacity/color combination is unreliable. Often the overlay paints but with wrong opacity or is hidden behind the image.
background_overlay.fallback: CSS: body.page-id-N .<section>::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background: rgba(...); z-index:1; } + content z-index:2

css_classes.root_cause: css_classes on CONTAINERS renders correctly (appears in class attribute). css_classes on WIDGETS (heading, text-editor, button) does NOT render under V4 — the class is dropped from the widget wrapper.
css_classes.observed: Container: css_classes:'oc-hero' → class='... oc-hero ...' ✅. Widget: css_classes:'oc-reveal-text' on text-editor → class='elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor' (no custom class) ❌.
css_classes.format: Must be a space-separated STRING, not an array. Arrays render as literal 'Array' in the class attribute.

flex_direction.notes: flex_direction:'row' / 'column' renders correctly. V4 maps to e-flex / e-con markup.

flex_gap.root_cause: flex_gap renders on the container itself, but V4 e-con-full children default to width:100% which can collapse the gap visually (children stack regardless of gap). Fix children width first.

padding.root_cause: padding on top-level sections renders. padding on nested e-con-full containers can be overridden by V4's e-con-full { padding: 10px } default. Use !important in CSS for critical paddings.

min_height.notes: min_height:{unit:'vh',size:100} renders. Note: vh units cause issues on mobile with dynamic toolbars — consider px fallback.

_element_width.root_cause: _element_width:'initial' + _element_custom_width renders in data-settings but V4 e-con-full children still compute to width:100% in flex rows. The setting alone does not constrain the rendered width.

_element_custom_width.root_cause: See _element_width — the setting is stored but V4 e-con-full flex children ignore it visually.

header_size.notes: header_size:'h1'/'h2'/'p' controls the HTML tag. Renders correctly.

title_color.root_cause: title_color renders only when typography_typography='custom' is also set. Otherwise the kit/heading-default color wins.

image.notes: image widget image:{url, alt} renders. External URLs work (no media attachment ID needed for image widgets, unlike container background_image).

background_color_button.root_cause: Button background_color renders, but Elementor's default button stretch (width:100%) overrides the visual size. The color is correct but the button fills its container.

tabs.notes: accordion widget tabs:[{tab_title, tab_content}] renders and functions.

html.notes: html widget html (raw HTML) renders. Use for SVG marks, slider chrome, third-party embeds. Budget ≤ 15% of widgets.

companion_rules.else: font-size silently ignored, theme default applies
font-family may be overridden by kit/theme

v4_markup_facts.inner_wrapper: V4 does NOT emit .e-con-inner on full-width containers (V3 did). CSS selectors targeting .e-con-inner break.
v4_markup_facts.child_width_default: e-con-full children in flex rows compute to width:100% unless explicitly constrained via CSS flex/width.
